description: IRS Schedule C (Form 1040), Profit or Loss From Business (Sole Proprietorship), pages 1 and 2

tax_year.description: The tax year printed in the form header, e.g. 2025

proprietor.description: The sole proprietor filing the schedule

ssn.description: Proprietor's social security number, as NNN-NN-NNNN

business.description: Business information, lines A through E

principal_business_or_profession.description: Line A: principal business or profession, including product or service

business_code.description: Line B: the six-digit principal business code entered from the instructions, digits only

business_name.description: Line C: business name. Null if left blank

ein.description: Line D: employer ID number. Null if blank

street_address.description: Line E: business street address, including suite or room number

city_state_zip.description: Line E: city, town or post office, state and ZIP code, as printed

accounting_method.description: Line F: the accounting method whose box is checked. Null if no box is checked

materially_participated.description: Line G: did the proprietor materially participate in the business during the year True if Yes is checked, false if No is checked, null if neither box is checked.

started_or_acquired_this_year.description: Line H: true if the box is checked (business started or acquired this year), false if unchecked

made_payments_requiring_1099.description: Line I: did the business make payments that would require filing Form(s) 1099 True if Yes is checked, false if No is checked, null if neither box is checked.

filed_required_1099s.description: Line J: true only if the Yes box reads [x], false only if the No box reads [x]. If both Yes and No read [ ] (unchecked), return null

line_1_gross_receipts.description: Line 1: gross receipts or sales. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_1_statutory_employee.description: Line 1 checkbox: true if checked (income reported on a W-2 with the statutory employee box checked), false if unchecked

line_2_returns_and_allowances.description: Line 2: returns and allowances. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_3_net_receipts.description: Line 3: line 1 minus line 2. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_4_cost_of_goods_sold.description: Line 4: cost of goods sold, from line 42. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_5_gross_profit.description: Line 5: gross profit, line 3 minus line 4. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_6_other_income.description: Line 6: other income, including fuel tax credit or refund. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_7_gross_income.description: Line 7: gross income, lines 5 plus 6. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

expenses.description: Part II, Expenses. Each amount comes from the amount cell beside its own line number; the grid has two columns, lines 8-17 on the left and 18-27b on the right

line_8_advertising.description: Line 8: advertising. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_9_car_and_truck.description: Line 9: car and truck expenses. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_10_commissions_and_fees.description: Line 10: commissions and fees. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_11_contract_labor.description: Line 11: contract labor. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_12_depletion.description: Line 12: depletion. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_13_depreciation.description: Line 13: depreciation and section 179 expense deduction. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_14_employee_benefit_programs.description: Line 14: employee benefit programs. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_15_insurance.description: Line 15: insurance other than health. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_16a_mortgage_interest.description: Line 16a: mortgage interest paid to banks. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_16b_other_interest.description: Line 16b: other interest. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_17_legal_and_professional.description: Line 17: legal and professional services. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_18_office_expense.description: Line 18: office expense. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_19_pension_and_profit_sharing.description: Line 19: pension and profit-sharing plans. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_20a_rent_vehicles_equipment.description: Line 20a: rent or lease of vehicles, machinery and equipment. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_20b_rent_other_property.description: Line 20b: rent or lease of other business property. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_21_repairs_and_maintenance.description: Line 21: repairs and maintenance. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_22_supplies.description: Line 22: supplies not included in Part III. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_23_taxes_and_licenses.description: Line 23: taxes and licenses. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_24a_travel.description: Line 24a: travel. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_24b_deductible_meals.description: Line 24b: deductible meals. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_25_utilities.description: Line 25: utilities. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_26_wages.description: Line 26: wages less employment credits. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_27a_energy_efficient_buildings.description: Line 27a: energy efficient commercial buildings deduction. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_27b_other_expenses.description: Line 27b: other expenses, from line 48. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_28_total_expenses.description: Line 28: total expenses before expenses for business use of home. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_29_tentative_profit.description: Line 29: tentative profit or (loss), line 7 minus line 28. Negative for a loss. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_30_business_use_of_home.description: Line 30: expenses for business use of home. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_31_net_profit_or_loss.description: Line 31: net profit or (loss), line 29 minus line 30. Negative for a loss. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_32_at_risk.description: Line 32 (32a or 32b): the at-risk box marked [x]. Only filled in when line 31 is a loss. If both boxes read [ ] (unchecked), return null; do not infer all_at_risk

cost_of_goods_sold.description: Part III, Cost of Goods Sold, on page 2

line_35_beginning_inventory.description: Line 35: inventory at beginning of year. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_36_purchases.description: Line 36: purchases less cost of items withdrawn for personal use. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_40_total.description: Line 40: lines 35 through 39 added. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_41_ending_inventory.description: Line 41: inventory at end of year. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_42_cost_of_goods_sold.description: Line 42: cost of goods sold. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

vehicle_placed_in_service.description: Part IV, line 43: date the vehicle was placed in service for business, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null if blank

other_expenses.description: Part V, Other Expenses, on page 2

items.description: Each other-expense line listed in Part V. Empty if none are listed

amount.description: Amount of the expense. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.

line_48_total.description: Line 48: total other expenses. If the amount cell for this line is empty, return null, not 0; return 0 only if a 0 is printed.
